corrections.corrected_statement: Blind spots are roadway areas not visible in mirrors during operation, while head checks mean turning the head and looking over the shoulder toward the intended movement.
corrections.note: Blind spots is on page 11 but head checks is on page 12.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Revocation ends the privilege to drive, suspension withdraws it temporarily, denial withholds driving privilege, and disqualification withdraws commercial privilege temporarily or permanently.
corrections.note: Denied and disqualification are on page 11, not page 13.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A personal motorized mobility device has two non-tandem ground wheels, steering and stopping under normal use, a motor capped at the stated small power limit, and a standing deck.
corrections.note: Definition is on page 13, not page 12.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Division means the Driver License Division of the Department of Public Safety, operator means a person in actual physical control, and highway means the full width between property lines available for vehicular travel.
corrections.note: Division is on page 11, not page 12.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Required driver education includes six hours of behind the wheel instruction and six hours of observation by a licensed instructor which may be required by school.
corrections.note: Added the may be required by school condition.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Adults nineteen or older without a license may qualify after holding a learner permit for ninety days with forty hours of driving including ten after sunset, or by finishing driver education to waive the wait.
corrections.note: Same statement found on page sixteen not seventeen.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver younger than eighteen may drive a Class D vehicle only with an approved instructor, a licensed parent or guardian, a signing adult, or another licensed adult aged twenty-one or older with parental permission.
corrections.note: Same options begin on page sixteen not seventeen.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A sixteen year old license holder may not drive between midnight and five in the morning and may carry only immediate family members for six months unless accompanied by a licensed driver age twenty one in the front seat or on agricultural assignment or in an emergency, with driving to and from work or a school sponsored activity as an added nighttime exception only.
corrections.note: Separated nighttime and passenger exceptions and added accompaniment.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Behind the wheel training requires six hours of driving instruction and six hours of observation by a licensed instructor which may be required by school.
corrections.note: Added the may be required by school condition.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers aged 15 to 18 must finish approved driver education and log 40 hours with a parent or guardian, with 10 hours after sunset
corrections.note: Same rule found on page sixteen not seventeen.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers 19 or older may skip driver education by holding a learner permit 90 days and logging 40 hours with 10 hours after sunset
corrections.note: Same rule found on page sixteen not seventeen.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A learner permit stays in immediate possession while driving and the front-seat supervisor must be a licensed driver
corrections.note: Same possession rule found on page seventeen not eighteen.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Holding periods are 6 months at age 16 or 17, none at age 18 with driver education, and 90 days at age 19 or older
corrections.note: Same holding periods found on page seventeen not nineteen.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Social security showing needs a signed government card or else a W-2, SSA-1099, non-SSA-1099, pay stub, or an agency ineligibility letter tied to lawful presence status.
corrections.note: Statement is correct on page 25, not page 24.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Utah residence and mailing showing needs two documents bearing name and address and dated within ninety days, drawn from bank statement, court papers, mortgage or rental contract, major credit-card bill, property-tax notice, school transcript, utility bill, or vehicle title.
corrections.note: Statement is correct on page 25, not page 24.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: First Utah license proof of driving experience means driver-education completion when under nineteen, or else an existing driving privilege from another state or country, and it is not required for a learner permit or ID card.
corrections.note: Statement is correct on page 25, not page 24.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Limited term identity needs one paper that is either an unexpired employment authorization document verified through SAVE or an unexpired foreign passport with valid visa and arrival record verified through SAVE.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported federal status list; kept only SAVE options stated on page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A driving privilege card needs one primary paper such as a foreign birth certificate or unexpired foreign passport with translation when needed, plus one secondary paper such as church, court, school, employee, insurance, consular, voter, license, or prior DPC records, plus SSN or ITIN proof and a sealed fingerprint card with photo for an original.
corrections.note: Statement is correct on page 27, not page 28.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Restriction codes limit vehicle, speed and medical conditions.
corrections.note: Statement is correct on page 22, not page 23.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Identity, residence and driving-experience proofs form the triad.
corrections.note: Statement is supported on page 23, not page 24.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Renewal, replacement and address-change duties group by timing.
corrections.note: Replacement and address duties are stated on page 29, not page 28.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Scored skills include attitude, technique, posture and lane use, turns, starts and stops, hill and parallel parking, signs and signals, backing, U-turns, steering, intersections, lane changes, and safe operation.
corrections.note: Lane changes and safe operation appear on page 34, not page 33.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A failed skills test needs more practice first, allows only one skills test per day with possible waits, needs another fee after three failures, and all tests must finish within six months of paying.
corrections.note: The retest rules appear on page 34, not page 35.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Even one drink of alcohol can affect a persons ability to operate a motor vehicle.
corrections.note: Original was truncated with no claim; replaced with a complete supported sentence from page 61.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A person under twenty one driving with any measurable alcohol loses driving privileges for six months for a first offense and for two years or until age twenty one whichever is longer for a second offense within ten years of a prior denial.
corrections.note: Added the ten year window and until age twenty one whichever is longer qualifier.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Over 0.05 BAC breaks the law, and 0.04 does so for CDL holders in Utah.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but appears on page 62, not page 63.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: If you refuse the chemical test chosen by the officer your license is revoked for eighteen months for a first offense and thirty six months for a later offense except drivers under twenty one face two years or until age twenty one whichever is longer for a first offense and thirty six months or until age twenty one whichever is longer for later offenses.
corrections.note: Added the under twenty one revocation exception.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A suspension for mandatory grounds can run as long as two years or until age twenty-one.
corrections.note: Duration language is printed on page 80, not page 81.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Revocation follows findings such as manslaughter or auto homicide, a repeat intoxicated-control offense, a false oath on application, felony use of a vehicle, failing to aid after a fatal or injury crash, fleeing police, firing or releasing weapons or incendiary items from a vehicle, restricted-status alcohol or interlock breaches, ordered careless-driving revocation, auto homicide with a handheld device, test refusal, and two road-rage citations in a year.
corrections.note: Full revocation list spans page 81 continuing onto page 82, not page 82 alone.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Do not assume a motorcycle will turn just because its turn signal is flashing because many motorcycle signals do not cancel on their own and the rider may have forgotten to turn the signal off.
corrections.note: Removed bicycle reference because the page states the warning for motorcycles only.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A driver passing a person on a bicycle must leave at least three feet of space beside that rider.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but appears on the next page, not the cited page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: On a one way street, the rear flag should be placed two hundred feet to the rear of the stopped vehicle.
corrections.note: Changed must to should to match the page wording.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: When the tow connection is a chain, rope, or cable, a red flag or other signal must be attached to the connection and any flag must be no smaller than twelve inches square.
corrections.note: Added the allowed other signal alternative and the flag size minimum.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: No person may operate a train of vehicles when any trailer or other towed vehicle whips or swerves dangerously or unreasonably from side to side.
corrections.note: Added other towed vehicles and unreasonably swerving to match the page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Warning devices must be displayed whenever a disabled or stopped vehicle that is at least eighty inches wide or thirty feet long remains along the road for more than ten minutes.
corrections.note: Added the eighty inch and thirty foot size thresholds from the page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Buses recreational vehicles and trailers eighty inches or more in width must have two amber lights on the front and two red lights on the rear plus one on each side visible from five hundred feet at night.
corrections.note: Added eighty inch threshold, lamp counts and placement, and night visibility.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: All vehicles except motorcycles must have at least two white headlights with one on each side that shine three hundred fifty feet on high beam and one hundred feet on low beam.
corrections.note: Added motorcycle exception, two lamp rule, and beam distances.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Vehicles must have two red tail and stop lights mounted on the rear visible from five hundred feet to the rear in regular sunlight.
corrections.note: Added two lamp requirement and sunlight visibility distance.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Vehicles must have two red yellow or amber turn signals on the rear and two white yellow or amber turn signals on the front visible from one hundred feet in normal sunlight.
corrections.note: Corrected front colors and added lamp counts and visibility distance.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: To drive a Class D vehicle you need twenty over forty vision in at least one eye with a visual field of at least ninety degrees and you must pass a vision test at a field office or when you are older than sixty five at application.
corrections.note: Narrowed to page thirty one vision rule and added missing vision numbers and age screening.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: After a review examination a hearing officer reviews the medical evaluation and driving needs and decides whether restrictions are needed, and driving privileges are withdrawn only when safe operation is impossible under any conditions.
corrections.note: Narrowed to page thirty two review and hearing officer decision without initial application step.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: A person convicted of texting while driving is guilty of a Class C misdemeanor with a maximum fine of one hundred dollars, or a Class B misdemeanor if they inflict bodily injury or have a previous violation for this offense.
corrections.note: Added the missing previous violation trigger for the higher penalty.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Shallow water reaching a car floor that causes loss of control differs from deeper moving water that can sweep away most vehicles including large trucks, and in both cases the rule is to turn around rather than cross
corrections.note: Statement is correct but printed on page sixty eight not page sixty nine.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Dimming for oncoming traffic at the longer distance differs from dimming when following at the shorter distance, and limited visibility also requires lights on and longer following space without tinted lenses at night
corrections.note: Statement is correct but the following distance and tinted lens rules are printed on page seventy one.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: To use a shared center left turn lane check mirrors signal left and check the left blind spot and enter no more than five hundred feet before the turn unless the last car is more than five hundred feet from the intersection.
corrections.note: Added the unless the last car exception.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Use acceleration lane to match speed; exit early and steady; metered ramp admits one vehicle per green
corrections.note: Meter rule completes on next page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Approach slow and scan; stop behind line; look left-right-left; cross without lane change; then merge right
corrections.note: Stop and lane rules are on next page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Continuous-flow, diverging-diamond and thru-U-turn each redirect lefts; follow staged signals and lane guides
corrections.note: Diverging diamond text is on next page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Yellow divides opposing flow; white divides same-direction flow; stop behind line and yield in crosswalk; shared center lane entry limited
corrections.note: Yellow and white meanings are on prior page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Basic law is reasonable-and-prudent; posted defaults by area; slow for hazards; too-slow impeding is citable
corrections.note: Hazard and impeding rules are on next page.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: Guide signs give directions and service information railroad crossings require slowing looking listening and stopping discipline regulatory signs command traffic and yellow diamond signs warn of possible danger ahead with no doubled fine or flagger rule stated on the provided pages.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported work zone fine and flagger claim.
corrections.applied_by: Sol acting coordinator; founder-authorized final VA/UT/TX export

corrections.corrected_statement: The provided pages do not state general right of way priority rules and page fifty seven only describes railroad crossing regulatory and route number signs.
